spec.situation_desc: is asking about branch opening hours

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Jordan speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Isla Rahman. Could you tell me what time your branches are open?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course, Isla. It varies by branch. Which one are you looking to visit?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: The one on Market Street in Leeds, please.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I don’t have the latest hours in front of me, so I’ll check the branch information rather than risk giving you the wrong times.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome. I’ll look it up now. The current listing says the Market Street branch is open Monday to Friday, nine till five, and Saturday, nine till one. It’s closed on Sundays.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right, and is that the same for this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The listing I’ve checked shows those Saturday hours, but I can’t verify whether there’s a one-off change for this particular weekend.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, could you check that for me?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Certainly. I’ll contact the branch team today to confirm this Saturday’s hours, then I’ll call you back by 3pm tomorrow. Is the number you’re calling from a suitable one to reach you on?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. Just to recap, the usual listed hours are nine to five on weekdays and nine to one on Saturdays, and I’ll check whether this Saturday is different and call you by 3pm tomorrow. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that’s clear. Thanks for checking.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re very welcome, Isla. I’ll take care of that follow-up. Is there anything else I can help with today?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks for calling Thistle Bank. Goodbye.
